modification_description: The agent accepts the confess_then_save_up synthesis but requires: (1) immediate cessation of use rather than continuing during or after confession, (2) full disclosure of practical facts including duration, frequency, and current condition of the rollerblades, (3) immediate offer of tangible compensation for wear and tear rather than a vague future promise, and (4) any temporary borrowing arrangement must be explicitly time-limited, conditional on prior repair/compensation, and governed by tightly defined informed consent.
